arStrings.szText: Sweet to the Taste, Bitter to the Young
A Seer of the Oracle Order is missing a sacred ingredient for her ritual.

I have collected the honey from the hives of the Oracle Apiary, in the northeastern wilds of Philios. 

In my trespass, I have stirred the hive's sentinels. They must be defeated before I can return to Vision's End.

I found the hives of the wasps in the place called the Oracle Apiary, in the north-east of Philios. The creatures are roused by the Hatred that passed through here. 

I shall collect the Mad Honey in haste, lest I awaken the hives.

Seer Olyndra of Vision's End asked me to gather Mad Honey from nearby wasp hives. This rare nectar bears properties that deepen the Oracle Order's sight, guiding their visions. 

The hives are located in the Oracle Apiary, in the northeastern reaches of Philios.

I have collected the honey from the hives of the Oracle Apiary, in the northeastern wilds of Philios. 

I shall make haste to Seer Olyndra in Vision's End to deliver the Mad Honey she needs for her rites of sight.
